title: When technology meets dictatorship, a 19-year-old tries to save humanity
author: Guilty-Manner219
selftext:
**RaviWar: A Perfect Sonday (Free To Play ,** [Wishlist Now](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5266980/RaviWar_1_A_Perfect_Sonday/)**)**

  
The world changed in 2037, when an entity called **Consensus** took control of humanity.

Consensus can control the minds of every human. Over the years, it made everyone live inside one massive building called Takarek, a building with 17,769 floors.

It is now 2077.

**You play as Alex**, a 19 year old Deprecation Clerk. Your job is to review old and unused data and delete it forever.

It is just another night at work, until you receive a **mysterious letter**:

DON'T LET RK-001 BE DELETED.  
IT'S THE ONLY WAY OUT OF TAKAREK.

You don't know who sent the letter. You don't know what RK-001 is. But you decide to find out.

What starts as a normal night at work slowly turns into a journey through the hidden parts of Takarek. You will discover forgotten information, strange clues, secrets from the past, and the truth about Consensus.

And somehow, you may be the only person who can stop it.

The world belongs to Consensus.  
But tonight, you have one chance to change that.



*As I have heavily used claude code and few other AI tools during the development, for some reason I am feeling very guilty even though I know it would have been impossible for me to develop a game of this scale all by myself.*
